hypothesis: The global Lloyd scale loses teacher fidelity because one or more RSTB fusion layers are scale-sensitive. Selecting max-range or Lloyd scaling independently for each of the four layers can retain the ground-truth and edge gains without changing the packed representation size.

alternate.scale: four-step Lloyd signed int7 per output

diagnostic_gate.composition: 200 deterministic RICO held-out frames plus one deterministic sample from each of 204 FLORES languages
diagnostic_gate.rank: Pareto-first on ground-truth, edge, and teacher PSNR relative to mask 0; then largest minimum of the three deltas
diagnostic_gate.advance: At most four non-endpoint masks advance to the complete development bundle. A mask must be nonnegative on at least two of the three diagnostic metrics.

development_gate.selection: Largest positive ground-truth gain among candidates with positive aggregate deltas on all three metrics and no negative mean in any source, split, script, or language group. Otherwise retain mask 0.

runtime_constraint: The selected candidate must use the existing four signed-int7 per-output tensors and therefore have identical packed bytes and kernel behavior to mask 0.
